description: This file defines interfaces and classes for message channels used in distributed communication, specifically via Azure Storage Queues. It includes channel creation, message sending, receiving, and acknowledgment handling.

classes.name: SendChannel
classes.description: Implements the ISendChannel interface for sending messages and awaiting acknowledgments via Azure queues.

classes.name: ReceiveChannel
classes.description: Implements the IReceiveChannel interface for waiting for messages and sending acknowledgments.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: Provides static methods to create send and receive channels, and a utility method to wait for messages from a queue.

methods.name: SendChannel.SendMessages
methods.description: Serializes and sends a list of server messages to the write queue, then waits for acknowledgment messages from the read queue.

methods.name: ReceiveChannel.WaitForMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a message from the queue, deserializes it, and returns it.

methods.name: ReceiveChannel.SendAck
methods.description: Creates and sends an acknowledgment message for a given server message.

methods.name: Channels.CreateSendChannel
methods.description: Creates and initializes a send channel asynchronously using either a queue URI or a QueueServiceClient.

methods.name: Channels.CreateReceiveChannel
methods.description: Creates and initializes a receive channel asynchronously using either a queue URI or a QueueServiceClient.

methods.name: Channels.WaitForMessage
methods.description: Extension method that waits for a message in a queue, deserializes it, and returns the message object.
